page_title: The Butcher of Bosnia Meets the Stars
date_caption: Created August 28, 2026 for the 35th week of 2026.

news.title: Bosnian Serb convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic dies - Al Jazeera

weekly_forecast: With Ratko Mladic's dramatic exit from the mortal coil, the UN tribunal in The Hague will now pivot to debating whether his ghost should stand trial. Meanwhile, conspiracy theorists will claim he faked his death using a body double made of Balkan cheese. Expect at least one world leader to tweet 'Thoughts and prayers' while secretly Googling 'how to avoid war crimes charges.'
